mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays below its recent average while TRANSIT remains depressed, weekday exposure to city-center shopping falls and RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 28-day mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below their current 28-day averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in GROCERY_PHARM indicates households are shifting trips toward essential errands, which displaces discretionary shopping and pushes RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the following 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above 15 points.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls further from an already low base, access to retail districts weakens and RETAIL_REC will decline within one week as fewer cross-neighborhood shopping trips occur.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after TRANSIT drops below -25 points.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived rise in PARKS mobility during the holiday season diverts leisure time away from malls and shopping streets, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns positive for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or remains unchanged over the next 14 days while PARKS stays positive for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated and WORKPLACES remain depressed at the same time, people consolidate into home-based routines and make fewer discretionary retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays above 3 points and WORKPLACES stays below -8 points.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both rise together, households are substituting toward essential and outdoor activities, which should reduce discretionary retail visits and pull RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 28 days while both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS remain above their current 4-week means.

mechanism_narrative: In a restriction regime, a sustained drop in TRANSIT below WORKPLACES amplifies access frictions more than labor demand, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays at least 10 points below WORKPLACES
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT remaining at least 10 points below WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: During the pre-holiday shopping window, a modest improvement in retail access can translate into stronger store visitation, so a rebound in TRANSIT from its current trough should lift RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -27.3 to -21.0 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 7 days after TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points week-on-week.
